c74object.name: evi_randy
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Cubic interpolated version of the linear MSP rand~
c74object.description:
evi_randy is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_randy is also available in MSP as: evi.randy~.
Being cubic interpolated the spectrum of this random oscillator rolls off much more steeply than the output of rand~, which may or may not be useful. At LFO frequencies this is a really useful smooth control source. @see: 'evi_sources.genexpr' and 'evi_lfo.genexpr' for more like this.

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: in Hz @min 0.. Frequency at which to sample new values internally, controlling the speed of the segments.
